goal: Original visual and gameplay fidelity at shared actor checkpoint

reference.title: Dungeon Hunter 2 (v1.0.3) Part 1 [720p]

frames_inspected.scope: overview of timestamped extracted stills, not continuous video viewing

reference.version_difference: Reference title v1.0.3; recovered asset documentation v1.0.2. Record differences before parity claims.

actual_format.note: Source title says 720p, acquired stream is 640x360. Local screenshot 1280x720; aspect ratios match.

integrated_evidence.observation: Prince is clearly rendered on textured swamp floor, with architecture and water visible. No weapon/shield attachment, HUD, target marker or other actors visible in this capture. This describes the inspected checkpoint only.

comparisons.required: Framing, FOV, tilt, actor screen position, follow lag, zoom, camera motion/cuts
comparisons.method: Select reference and local clips of same location, actor position and movement path; compare landmarks and actor screen occupancy at matched aspect ratio, then trace motion over time.
comparisons.required_evidence: Timestamped reference frames and local clips with camera pose/FOV/viewport logged
comparisons.current_limit: Current integrated frame uses development framing; no original camera parity established

comparisons.required: Brightness, ambient tint, local light placement, water/character light response and shadows
comparisons.method: Compare same view and materials under matched game state; sample floor/actor/background patches, inspect over movement.
comparisons.required_evidence: Timestamped reference frame, local frame and lighting configuration
comparisons.current_limit: Fixed ambient/directional baseline plus original vertex color is not evidence of original light/shadow behavior

comparisons.required: Actor height versus floor/architecture, floor contact, facing, NPC/mob placement, weapon/shield/armor attachments
comparisons.method: Compare landmark ratios and feet contact; use original placement definitions and bone attachment transforms alongside reference close-ups.
comparisons.required_evidence: Original actor/equipment definitions, actor world matrices, same-view reference and local frames
comparisons.current_limit: Single Prince visible without weapon/shield; multi-actor placement and attachment parity unverified

comparisons.required: Idle/walk/run/stance/attack poses, clip choice, playback rate, transitions, root displacement and event timing
comparisons.method: Capture fixed-step frame sequences; align named animation start and visible hit/contact moments against reference. Compare body and attachment silhouettes and measured durations.
comparisons.required_evidence: Timestamped reference clip, local clip, selected animation, sample time, event and hit logs
comparisons.current_limit: Single still establishes pose display only; no reference timing or hit alignment

comparisons.required: Diffuse/alpha textures, UVs, cutout, blending, additive, vertex colors, culling, depth order and original effect coverage
comparisons.method: Inspect foreground foliage/water/transparency overlaps at multiple camera angles; compare matched reference frames and record unsupported effect types.
comparisons.required_evidence: Material/texture/effect identifiers, reference/local matched frames and renderer diagnostics
comparisons.current_limit: Generic fixed-function renderer with approximate center sorting; asset provenance is not effect parity

comparisons.required: Health/mana bars, target indicators, icons, layout, sizing and truthfulness of displayed values
comparisons.method: Match viewport and reference gameplay state; compare icon/layout proportions, target identity and values against authoritative actor state.
comparisons.required_evidence: Reference timestamps during targeting/damage, local frames and authoritative health/mana/target logs
comparisons.current_limit: HUD and target indicators absent from inspected integrated capture

comparisons.required: Attack/cast/hit/death effects, particle placement/lifetime, cinematic presentation and synchronized audio
comparisons.method: Align event start and lifecycle in reference/local clips; inspect effect anchors, fade, size, sound starts and camera cuts.
comparisons.required_evidence: Timestamped event clips, original effect/audio definitions and local event logs
comparisons.current_limit: No event or cinematic reference sequence inspected

comparisons.required: Movement speed/turning/collision, targeting range, attack cadence, reactions/death and interaction behavior
comparisons.method: Replay matched scenarios and record actor positions/actions/targets/hits over time; distinguish walkthrough observations from hidden rules.
comparisons.required_evidence: Timestamped reference scenario plus deterministic local replay and authored rules
comparisons.current_limit: Still image cannot demonstrate gameplay parity

findings: RenderQueue copies each actor transform and applies it to transparent range center before camera-depth sorting. Mesh buffers must remain alive and unchanged until flush.
Latest main still submits one character through translation only and has not integrated RenderQueue; multiple actor rotation/scale/bone attachment transforms are pending.
New RenderQueue source gathers all scene/actor ranges and sorts transformed centers globally; latest main reviewed has not adopted it. Intersecting transparent geometry remains approximated.

acceptance: Timestamped stills have now been inspected. Findings are preliminary unmatched-state observations; no dimension has reached matched-state fidelity acceptance. Continuous animation/gameplay/timing/audio remain not_compared.
